summary: Playback and capture work through one audio service (audiod) that apps reach over a socket, and the service decodes AAC, FLAC, Vorbis and WAV internally. Apps get transport and record calls only; there is no SDK codec, converter, file-services, audio-unit or audio-session API.

features.feature: Playback and queue (Audio Queue Services, Music Player)
features.apple: AudioQueue, MPMusicPlayer-style queues via Audio Queue Services and Music Player
features.note: Music and Podcasts play through the audio service: PlayQueue, Play, Pause, Next, Prev, SeekMs, SetShuffle, SetRepeat, SetVolume. One queue and one speaker, last PlayQueue wins. No app-side buffer callbacks.
ALSA capture to WAV with a level meter, only through the service (RecordStart, RecordStop). Apps get no raw sample callback.

features.feature: Audio Unit v2 render API (AudioUnit, render callbacks, I/O start and stop)
features.note: Pure render model with host unit tests, and parameters are a ranged table with clamped writes, reset and unknown-id refusal (parameter tests in springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-36.rs). Gap: no SDK render callback, the PCM output path stays inside the springboard crate, and nothing is wired into apps or the shell or tested on the VM or Midget.

features.feature: Audio Unit v3 plug-ins and AUAudioUnit host (parameters, presets, buses)
features.apple: AUAudioUnit, AUAudioUnitBus, AUParameterTree, AUAudioUnitPreset, AUv3 app extensions
features.note: Wave 3 (theme-31, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No plug-in host, extension point or parameter tree. Searched for audio unit, plugin and parameter terms in springboard/.

ComponentRegistry registers components by kind, sub-kind and manufacturer, finds the next match with wildcards and instantiates a render unit (host unit tests in audio_render.rs). Gap: no SDK-facing registration or plug-in loading, codecs are still chosen by sniffing in springboard/src/media/codec.rs, and nothing is wired into apps or the shell or tested on the VM or Midget.

features.feature: Audio file parsing and demuxing (Audio File Stream, Audio File, Extended Audio File)
features.bifrost: springboard/src/media/mp4.rs, springboard/src/media/symfile.rs, springboard/src/media/audiofile.rs, springboard/src/media/codec.rs, springboard/src/media/stream.rs, springboard/src/media/capture.rs (wav_duration_ms)
features.note: File kind by extension and by magic bytes, and WAV duration from the header, are tested headless in springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-os-10.rs. Gap: there is no app-facing demuxer, so an app cannot open a file and read its packets through the SDK.

features.feature: Audio codec and format conversion (Audio Converter, Audio Format Services)
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/pcm_convert.rs (convert_bytes, PcmFormat, decode, encode); wired: springboard/apps/daw/src/export.rs (converted_wav), springboard/apps/daw/src/wav.rs (encode_s16), springboard/ui/src/pcm_convert.rs (Resampler, f32_to_s16); springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-47.rs
features.note: convert_bytes converts linear PCM between sample depths, channel layouts and sample rates; headless tests in parity_sdk-complete-47.rs cover each path, the refused partial frames and the one-shot frame count. Gap: no encoder and no compressed-format codec API; AAC-LC decoding runs in the system layer, and the converter is not yet tested on the VM or Midget.

features.feature: Audio session and output route (headphones, speaker)
features.apple: Audio session support (route, category, interruption handling)
features.bifrost: springboard/src/media/route.rs, springboard/src/media/volume.rs, springboard/audio/alsa/src/ctl.rs; springboard/sdk/src/audio_session.rs (SessionHub: categories, activation, interruptions, route changes)
features.note: Categories, activation, interruptions and route-change events are tested headless in springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-os-10.rs. Gap: no shell service drives the session hub yet, so the headphone cap and the service's audio focus are not reported to apps.

features.feature: System sounds and alert playback (Audio Services)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 8 tests. Wave 3 (theme-31, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No system-sound or alert API. A search for sound effect and beep terms in springboard/src found nothing.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. Wave 4 (theme-16, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No scheduled playback of file regions. The service plays whole tracks.

features.feature: Voice I/O (Audio Unit Voice I/O, echo cancellation)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. Wave 5 (w5-audio-toolbox, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Capture has no echo cancellation or voice processing stage.

features.feature: Spatial audio (spatial mixer, head tracking, AUHeadTrackingBinauralRenderer)
features.apple: Spatial mixer audio unit, AUHeadTrackingBinauralRenderer, spatial audio structs
features.note: Tied to Apple headphone head-tracking hardware and services. No counterpart on a Linux PC.

features.feature: Audio debugging, Instruments and Apple silicon porting
features.apple: Analyzing audio performance with Instruments, Audio Toolbox Debugging, Porting your audio code to Apple silicon
features.note: Developer tooling for Apple platforms. BifrOSt has no Instruments counterpart for audio.

gaps: No SDK API for raw audio buffers or render callbacks; apps can only use transport and record calls on the audio service
No audio unit or audio component host (AUv3 or AUv2), and no parameter tree
No system sound or alert API (AudioServices)
No general format converter or encoder API for apps
No app-facing audio session category, interruption or route API (system layer only)
No scheduled playback of file regions
No voice processing (echo cancellation) on capture
